notes: Manual Homeland work ability values merged LAST by scripts/scrape-aniimo.js, so they win over anything scraped.
Match is by species + form. If no scraped record matches, a new record is created.
skills replaces the whole ability set for that record (unlisted abilities become 0).
Prismana records display as 'Prismana <Species>' with form 'Prismana'.

categories (optional) sets an Aniimo's category by species (and optional form): common, prismana or legendary. It wins over the scraped category. Use it if the planner offers an Aniimo by default that you cannot normally catch, or hides one you can.
dexNumbers gives an Aniilog number to species whose Aniilog badge is not a number (the starters show 'Starter'). Every kept record needs a number.

exclusions removes records that are not Aniimo a player can own, with the reason shown in scrape.excluded. Match by id, or species (+ optional form). The scraper already removes anything the Aniilog does not number, boss entities and Hideout-only Prismana forms automatically; list a record here only when that isn't enough or a clearer reason helps.
renames: { from, to, reason } renames a species (all its forms) when aniimo.gg shows a placeholder name for an Aniimo the game names differently.
